about: Post-hoc, exploratory checks of C1 (Run C) made by the agents after Run C, some read next to B2; not registered, and they cannot change a registered verdict. Computed only from the files named in sources.

kept_draws_reproduced.definition: The registered selector applied to C1's clip rows keeps the stored kept run for every arm and item, and applied to B2's rows does so for S* and S*_b0

j_reproduced.definition: J of every C1 arm, and of B2's S* and S*_b0, recomputed from the clip rows equals the stored J

bootstrap_index_reproduced.definition: sha256 of default_rng(0).integers(0, 96, (10000, 96)) as int64 bytes equals c1_result's bootstrap.index_sha256

r1_reproduced.definition: Delta_J, its 2.5th percentile and its 95% interval recomputed with that index equal c1_result's rule.R1

pooled_reproduced.definition: The exploratory pooled Delta_J and mean bo4 q difference over B2's 24 items then C1's 96, with default_rng(0).integers(0, 120, (10000, 120)), equal c1_result's pooled_with_b2

npa_v_times_notes_max_deviation.definition: Largest distance of NPA_v x (the line's note count) from a whole number over S*'s 384 clips; near 0 means NPA_v is a count of correct notes out of the line's notes

wr_times_words_max_deviation.definition: Largest distance of WR x (the line's word count) from a whole number over S*'s 384 clips

wins.definition: C1 items joint for S* and not for S*_b0

losses.definition: C1 items joint for S*_b0 and not for S*

ties.definition: C1 items joint for both or for neither

p_two_sided.definition: Exact two-sided binomial sign test on the untied items (p = 1/2), six significant digits

j.definition: J(S*) in C1, the share of the 96 items joint

ci95.definition: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of J(S*) over the registered C1 resamples, default_rng(0).integers(0, 96, (10000, 96))

share_ge_0_5.definition: Share of those 10,000 resamples with J(S*) >= 0.5, the R2 bar

n_items_joint.definition: Items (of 96) joint for S* as registered

n_items_joint_plus_1_note.definition: Items (of 96) joint for S* when every S* clip has one correct note more (dn = 1, dw = 0): NPA_v = (correct notes + dn) / n and WR = (matched words + dw) / n, n the line's word count (= its note count), each count kept within 0 and n, gate-failed clips at q = 0, the selector re-picking

n_items_joint_minus_1_note.definition: Items (of 96) joint for S* when every S* clip has one correct note fewer (dn = -1, dw = 0): NPA_v = (correct notes + dn) / n and WR = (matched words + dw) / n, n the line's word count (= its note count), each count kept within 0 and n, gate-failed clips at q = 0, the selector re-picking

n_items_joint_plus_1_word.definition: Items (of 96) joint for S* when every S* clip has one matched word more (dn = 0, dw = 1): NPA_v = (correct notes + dn) / n and WR = (matched words + dw) / n, n the line's word count (= its note count), each count kept within 0 and n, gate-failed clips at q = 0, the selector re-picking

n_items_joint_minus_1_word.definition: Items (of 96) joint for S* when every S* clip has one matched word fewer (dn = 0, dw = -1): NPA_v = (correct notes + dn) / n and WR = (matched words + dw) / n, n the line's word count (= its note count), each count kept within 0 and n, gate-failed clips at q = 0, the selector re-picking

n_items_joint_plus_1_note_and_1_word.definition: Items (of 96) joint for S* when every S* clip has one correct note and one matched word more (dn = 1, dw = 1): NPA_v = (correct notes + dn) / n and WR = (matched words + dw) / n, n the line's word count (= its note count), each count kept within 0 and n, gate-failed clips at q = 0, the selector re-picking

n_items_joint_minus_1_note_and_1_word.definition: Items (of 96) joint for S* when every S* clip has one correct note and one matched word fewer (dn = -1, dw = -1): NPA_v = (correct notes + dn) / n and WR = (matched words + dw) / n, n the line's word count (= its note count), each count kept within 0 and n, gate-failed clips at q = 0, the selector re-picking

items_lost_minus_1_note.definition: S*'s joint items that are no longer joint with one correct note fewer

items_gained_plus_1_note.definition: S*'s non-joint items that become joint with one correct note more

delta_j_b2.definition: B2's J(S*) - J(S*_b0), on its 24 test items (S*_b0 alone; B2's registered P1 took the max over comparators, which was S*_b0's J too)

delta_j_c1_minus_b2_ci95.definition: 95% interval of that difference: C1's 96 items resampled with default_rng(0).integers(0, 96, (10000, 96)) and B2's 24 items independently with default_rng(1).integers(0, 24, (10000, 24)), resample r of each paired

delta_j_c1_minus_b2_share_le_0.definition: Share of those 10,000 paired resamples where the difference is <= 0

mean_kept_q_diff_c1.definition: C1's mean over items of bo4 q(S*) - bo4 q(S*_b0)

mean_kept_q_diff_b2.definition: B2's mean over items of bo4 q(S*) - bo4 q(S*_b0)

mean_kept_q_diff_c1_minus_b2.definition: C1's mean kept q difference minus B2's

mean_kept_q_diff_c1_minus_b2_ci95.definition: 95% interval of that difference: C1's 96 items resampled with default_rng(0).integers(0, 96, (10000, 96)) and B2's 24 items independently with default_rng(1).integers(0, 24, (10000, 24)), resample r of each paired

j_b2_s_star.definition: B2's J(S*), share of its 24 test items joint

j_c1_s_star.definition: C1's J(S*), share of its 96 items joint

change_s_star_ci95.definition: 95% interval of that change, with the paired independent resamples of c1_vs_b2

j_b2_s_b0.definition: B2's J(S*_b0), share of its 24 test items joint

j_c1_s_b0.definition: C1's J(S*_b0), share of its 96 items joint

change_s_b0_ci95.definition: 95% interval of that change, with the paired independent resamples of c1_vs_b2

wordless_rate.definition: c1_result's wordless_rate per arm: share of the arm's scored clips whose Whisper transcript the registered scorer calls wordless (score_b2.wordless: empty or at least half vowel sounds, or only registered E4 hallucination strings and vowel sounds)

wordless_rate_reproduced.definition: The same share recomputed from the clip rows' wordless flags equals the stored rate for every arm

wordless_rate_b2.definition: b2_result's wordless_rate for S* and S*_b0, for comparison

kept_whisper_joint_also_ctc_stem_joint.definition: Per arm, over the 96 kept draws (kept by Whisper's q): whisper_joint = kept q >= 0.5; also_ctc_stem_joint = of those, q_ctc_stem = gate * min(NPA_v, CTC WR on the vocal stem) >= 0.5; share = also_ctc_stem_joint / whisper_joint; ctc_stem_joint = kept draws with q_ctc_stem >= 0.5 (J by CTC on the stem x 96); ctc_stem_joint_not_whisper = those not joint by Whisper

ctc_stem_j_reproduced.definition: ctc_stem_joint / 96 equals the stored J_ctc_stem of every arm

j1_c1.definition: C1's best-of-1 J: share of all (item, draw) clips with q >= 0.5, per arm

j1_reproduced.definition: Those equal best_of_n['1']['j'] stored in c1_result and b2_result

delta_j1_c1_ci95.definition: Its 95% interval over the registered C1 resamples, default_rng(0).integers(0, 96, (10000, 96)), the draws of an item kept together

delta_j1_b2_ci95.definition: Its 95% interval over B2's registered resamples, default_rng(0).integers(0, 24, (10000, 24))
